decisions.title: A faster or second chat-model vendor in the race
decisions.gain: 100–200 ms at the median in busy hours; covers the minutes when every DeepSeek copy is slow
decisions.basis: estimated: the chat model is ~360 of ~870 ms and 3× slower at 23:50 than after midnight
decisions.cost: A new account and key; answer quality with the 13k-character prompt must be checked
decisions.needs: An account and a key on the box; `llmprobe -try` measures a candidate in a minute

decisions.title: A second synthesis account, used as a pool of two
decisions.gain: The faster of two first audios on every turn instead of one (unmeasured; the tail is the point: 646 and 938 ms on the 09:34 call), and a second allowance of requests. Cures the multi-second stalls only if they turn out to be per account.
decisions.basis: measured 10-12, 30 rounds, both accounts asked at once: first audio p50 265 / p90 336 / worst 689 ms on the first account alone, 248 / 328 / 337 for the faster of the two; a first audio of 400 ms or more on 4 rounds, never on both at once. No multi-second stall occurred, so nothing is known about those.
decisions.cost: The two accounts' copies of the voice differ: the second speaks about 9% faster and about 3 dB louder. The owner heard both and keeps them as they are: both are his voice, and the variation from turn to turn is wanted.
decisions.guard: The assistant's voice (identical on both accounts); refused requests (an answer nobody hears)
decisions.undo: yes: remove the key; one key behaves exactly as before
decisions.needs: A call on the pool, to verify. Then the second account's real allowance (paced alone until refused), to set `tts_account_rpm` above the published 10 if it allows.
decisions.status: taken 10-12: on, racing every first segment; not yet heard on a call

decisions.title: Ask the model to open answers with one of a few short clauses
decisions.gain: ~195 ms on most turns; first audio immune to synthesizer stalls
decisions.basis: measured on cache-hit turns: 515–756 ms against ~870
decisions.cost: Changes how the assistant talks; openers repeat

decisions.title: A holding phrase on slow turns
decisions.gain: No change at the median; ends dead air at about 1.2 s in a stall
decisions.basis: built and off (holding_filler); fires at 1.5× the call's median
decisions.cost: First audio is then a phrase, not the answer; reported separately
decisions.guard: Moves the number without moving the answer
decisions.needs: A yes, and the phrases to use

decisions.title: Wired network, and providers routed outside the VPN tunnel
decisions.gain: Tens of ms per vendor round trip; possibly the synthesizer's stalls
decisions.basis: unknown; could not be measured without root
decisions.needs: Root, or the owner making the change

decisions.title: Ask for the recognizer's final 100 or 80 ms into a pause, not 120
decisions.basis: measured: 66 pauses on two calls; 100 ms splits 18–43% more recognitions, 80 ms 43–71% more
decisions.cost: More split recognitions on a line where recognition is already the weak point
decisions.needs: More pause data from quiet calls; leave at 120 for now

decisions.title: The synthesizer's HTTP endpoint as a second route in a stall
decisions.cost: Engineering time; same account and voice
decisions.needs: A probe that asks both routes at once
